# Paris by Pierre

> > Your curated guide to the best hotels and travel experiences in Paris, featuring luxury accommodations near iconic landmarks like the Champs-Élysées.

Paris by Pierre offers expert recommendations for travelers seeking the finest hotel experiences in the French capital. The site focuses on carefully selected accommodations across various price points, with special emphasis on properties in Paris city centre and near major attractions.
